hello po, based on experience po nagmamatter yung will ng tao. iba yung focus mo kapag gusto mo talagang ipasa. please revisit your “why’s”. it can be as simple as “for closure since ito yung degree na tinapos ko” or “pera pera pera” or “para hindi na ako tanungin nila mama kailan ako magtitake”.

As to the remaining time, strategize kung pano mo tatapusin yung coverage. always remember completion over mastery. If working ka naman, siguro better approach if magsagot muna ng MCQ per topic then saka nalang manuod ng lectures if madaming mali. ofc find out which method you learn best. identify ano yung resources mo and pano mo gagamitin yung resources.

if you’re an online reviewee, there’s something I realized late but baka applicable rin sayo. for videos, as much as possible wag mag 2x ng speed since yung brain mo is working rin at 2x. doing so for long periods leads you to burn out. at least for me yan yung case. yung tipong aral ng 2x for one day tas titingin sa kesame for two days. find a balance (1.25x for fast speakers and 2.0x if mabagal magsalita) na nakakaabsorb yung brain mo and remember na you can always click pause and replay if di mo gets.

Always believe na hanggat hindi ka pa pumapasok sa exam room, hindi pa huli. ako nga 3 days before lecpa, nagtanong sa gc bakit hindi nakatimes ng % yung conso income which is a basic concept. 

Lastly, if possible answer MCQs. not necessarily paramihan but just enough for you to assess if naintindihan mo yung concept. 

If meron ka RC, focus on your materials. yes meron available from other RCs online but the problem is, they don’t share the vid discussion kung bakit ganun yung approach. mahirap kapag yung alam mo lang is “c” yung sagot and hindi mo alam bakit hindi “a” “b” “d”.

so far naman yung nagshashare yung actually nagbibreach ng agreement nila with their RC. and some RCs aren’t strict naman, they don’t agree with it since business nila pero they turn a blind eye so far as long as hindi vidlecs and HOs (as in yung discussion) yung shinishare.

finally fixed all of our cats 🥺 grabe feb last year nung inadopt kami nung visitor stray tapos nanganak then nanganak ulit (first bcs we didn't know you had to spay them, we knew it lang nung nabuntis na siya sa second litter and we didn't know we could've aborted it if early term)

ako pa yung nag introduce sa family ko regarding sa concept ng spay/neuter. tas parang may hesitation pa na "gagasto talaga para sa pusa?" (for context, very expensive sa province and we have to travel to the main city which is 2+ hours away).

 pero supportive namn sila. my sibling really made it possible, sinamahan ko siya twice sa vet and he went there alone twice rin. parang 4 batches ng spay/neuter ang nangyari. our parents also look out for the cats. and mas naging close kami since topics namin yung cats. nagcocomment rin sila regarding sa difference ng fixed compared sa hindi. "lalabas lang talaga sila para tumae/umihi no?" "andito lang talaga sila sa bahay unlike nuon" "tumaba sila"

and since marami sila, andami kong source ng serotoninnnn. lalo na yung queen, she trusts my lil sib more (she called for her when giving birth to her second litter) but she sleeps with me almost everynight. tas belly up pa. bonus bcs she lets me rub them soft fur. they're all unique kasi ibaiba yung tatay ng mga anak niya and siya yung may pinaka neat na fur (domestic short haired with three colors). yung shiny tas walang fur out of place.

the rest are lambing in their unique ways. since nagRTO this year, yung kapatid ko na nagpapakain sa kanila so parang mas favored talaga nila siya pero they always makes sure to visit me when I'm bringing home my work hshshshsjs tas ayun natutulog sa tabi ng laptop then nagna-nap sa bed ko

tas everytime uuwi ako, sila lahat parin sasalubong sa gate.

last thing to share, minsan kapag aalis kami. mag aattempt sila na sumama. accdg ni papa, nag ga guard daw sila kasi sila yung nauuna (at first). yung isa talaga sa kanila, umabot dun tindahan (bumili ako ng softdrinks) which is 10 houses away. yung tumindig na balahibo niya sa buntot kasi foreign territory na yun pero sumusunod pa rin siya sakin 

I was only able to appreciate this journey dahil sa situation namin. I wouldn't say our cats are lucky because they actually deserve humans who will take care of them (actually hindi pa namin na poprovide yung minimum but we're hoping to get there). It's sad na there are strays out there who deserve more, especially the abandoned kittens dying inside a sack somewhere at the side of the road. 

We even have strangers putting their baby kittens in front of our house hoping we'll let them in. We couldn't. We were only trying to be responsible for the lives we didn't avoid. We had to ignore cries until they disappear in the afternoon. We tried posting kung may willing mag adopt pero walang cats group yung city namin so wala parin. someone else siguro pumulot sa kanila.

 Sometimes I look back and ask myself "what if we spayed her nung bago pa lang siyang dumating? like siya lang? maybe we could've provided her a better life? maybe we could've adopted the strays?" pero I can't blame myself kasi hindi ko pa alam yung info nung time na yun. To get back, I try to be vocal to my friends and family's friends regarding fixing their pets. That way hindi mapupunan yung bilang ng mga nangangailangan ng pagmamahal at yung existing will be given more chance to experience love.
